executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体信号偏弱，主要是面向通用个人 AI 助手的体验式对比，而非面向工程负责人可复用的技术方法、评测框架或基础设施设计。
唯一相对值得保留的是 Claire Vo 对 4 个 agent 在 9 个真实任务上的对比，因为它至少暴露了跨代理评测中的环境差异、任务分层和代码审查风险，但仍更偏产品体验而非严谨工程评测。
executive_summary_en: The candidate set is weak overall: most of it is consumer-style agent comparison content rather than reusable technical material for engineering leaders on evals, harnesses, repo understanding, or developer tooling.

The only borderline item worth keeping is Claire Vo’s 9-task comparison of 4 agents, because it at least surfaces benchmark setup differences, task segmentation, and code-review risk, though it remains more product-evaluation than rigorous engineering methodology.

items.title: Grok vs. Dot vs. Muse vs. Claude Duet: 9 Real Tasks | How I AI
items.author: Claire Vo
items.summary_zh: Claire Vo 用 9 个真实任务比较了 Grok、Dot、Muse 和 Claude Duet，覆盖 Slack 回复、短视频生成、bug 修复、Figma 缩略图、邮件分诊、家庭内容制作、作业解释、购物比较和产品发布视频。结论不是“单一总冠军”，而是不同 agent 在工作类、个人类和创意类任务上表现分化；同时，代码修复场景暴露出高风险变更仍需要人工审查。
items.summary_en: Claire Vo compares Grok, Dot, Muse, and Claude Duet across 9 real tasks including Slack replies, short video generation, bug fixes, Figma thumbnail ideation, inbox triage, family artifacts, homework explanations, shopping comparisons, and launch-video creation. The key conclusion is that there is no universal winner: performance splits by work, personal, and creative tasks, and the coding task shows that risky changes still require careful human review.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对工程与平台负责人而言，这篇内容的价值不在于“谁赢了”，而在于它提醒我们：多 agent 比测若没有统一权限、上下文窗口、工具接入和执行环境，结论很容易被系统边界而非模型能力主导。它也再次说明，把 coding agent 与个人助理混在一个总分榜里意义有限，评测应按任务族、风险级别和可验证性拆分。
items.why_it_matters_en: For engineering and platform leaders, the value is not in the winner but in the reminder that cross-agent comparisons are heavily shaped by access, context, tool integration, and execution environment. It also reinforces that lumping coding agents and personal assistants into one overall score is not very meaningful; evaluations should be segmented by task family, risk level, and verifiability.
key_takeaways_zh: 跨 agent 对比必须显式记录环境差异：权限、工具接入、UI/文档工作流和 computer-use 能力会直接影响结果。
代码任务中的“看似可用修复”仍可能引入危险验证逻辑变更，说明高风险改动必须有审查与测试护栏。
通用总分往往掩盖真实能力边界；更合理的是按工作流类别分别评测并建立分层路由策略。
key_takeaways_en: Cross-agent comparisons must explicitly capture setup differences: permissions, tool access, UI/document workflows, and computer-use capabilities materially change outcomes.
A coding task can produce a seemingly useful fix that introduces risky validation changes, underscoring the need for review and testing guardrails on high-risk edits.
Single overall rankings hide actual capability boundaries; task-family-specific evaluation and routing are more useful in practice.

task-family evaluation（按任务族分层评测）
themes_zh: Agent 评测正在从单轮问答转向真实工作流任务，但方法学仍不够严格。
不同代理在工作、个人与创意场景的能力边界日益明显，统一总分的参考价值下降。
themes_en: Agent evaluation is shifting from single-turn prompting to real workflow tasks, but the methodology remains loose.
Capability boundaries across work, personal, and creative scenarios are becoming clearer, making unified leaderboard-style scoring less useful.
implications_zh: 如果你的团队正在采购或内测 coding/desktop agents，应先建立自有任务集与统一执行环境，而不是依赖外部泛化榜单。
把代理按场景路由会比追求“一个全能 agent”更现实：例如 coding、文档整理、创意生成分别选型。
对代码修改类任务，必须把审查、测试、回滚和权限边界设计成默认路径。
implications_en: If your team is evaluating coding or desktop agents, build an internal task suite and normalized execution environment instead of relying on generic external rankings.
Scenario-based routing is more practical than searching for one universal agent: choose separately for coding, document work, and creative generation.
For code-change tasks, review, testing, rollback, and permission boundaries should be part of the default path.
